cutoff: BUY_INTENT decision time; teacher ledger separated; no post-entry inputs
excluded_first_pass: old Sign feature matrix/models/q/80% gate/v3 slots
model_family: new hierarchical/regularized logistic; common effect plus State/Transition/Path/activity/time
not_finalized: chronological FIT/CAL/TEST boundaries and teacher-maturity purge
exact block count and support limits
finite CAL thresholds and integer PLUS-miss budgets
minimum MINUS rejection, completed gate/session robustness/uncertainty limits
path: latest maximum six observed state runs in contiguous segment; current run truncated at BUY_INTENT, auxiliary changes retained within same Primary
state_aligned_activity: OHLC/price progress, Volume, Trading Value, active time, remaining active minutes and missingness; normalization scale must be fixed in final schema
state_semantics: as frozen, no prior win/loss meaning; no tenth missing state
teacher: net>0 PLUS, net<0 MINUS; ZERO/UNKNOWN/unresolved/no-fill preserved under frozen contracts
transition: adjacent observed runs only; previous/current Primary and duration/context/aux/activity change; reset on missing/session/lunch/contract boundaries
